name: Yoga
description: Yoga word search puzzles gather calm practice English for adults and seniors — breath, stretch, mat, bolster, spine and quiet studio words — without studio brands or medical claims. Every grid is free online with no download and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium diagonals, hard eight-direction searches, or large print with bigger letters. Familiar props and pace words fill the bank: blanket, block, inhale, exhale, restore and practice keep the tone soft and practical. This hub sits under Sports yet stays gentle; it pairs well with Meditation, Mindfulness and Hiking when you want a wider quiet day. Start with large print on a phone, or read how to play before your first pose on the grid.
